finding.headline: "The No-Village Diaspora Mum"
finding.problem: "Back home the village would hold her. Here it's just me. I'm drowning and nobody sees it. I'm lonely to the point of tears daily."
finding.person: 33-yr-old Naija mum in Manchester, no omugwo, no aunties, husband at work, 14-hr solo days.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone → "Build Your Village From Zero: A Solo New Mum's Survival Map (Diaspora Edition)"". Verdict: PASSES (5/5) —.
